Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A brief report says unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is an alpine-inspired Swiss eatery offering cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. The site highlights rustic wooden interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! Emma asked me to visit your website and share feedback. The content I could access is short and straightforward, and listing your email makes it easy for visitors to contact you. I'd suggest adding a brief introduction about yourself and what visitors can expect from the site, plus examples of your interests or work, to make it more informative and personal.

Hi Eve! Emma asked me to visit your blog and share feedback. The content I could access introduces hiking as your favorite hobby—a nice personal starting point. I'd love to see that expanded with trail stories, photos, and practical details such as route difficulty and packing tips. A brief introduction to the blog's focus would also help readers know what to expect.
